notablePrerequisites: Living Hive does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive.
Living Hive triggers, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar at least five times by sacrificing at least five Insects, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
